persistedData.description: The final data frame produced by the agent

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
In order to support sources that may be shared among multiple queries over time, the id should be generated
deterministically. For example, a hash of the source type name combined with the stringified
{@link Genai.StructuredQuery.Spec}. This is not a requirement, but could prove useful.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

displayName.description:
A fallback display name for a source. This will only be used if a {@link Genai.Query.ResultToSourceRelation} for a
{@link Genai.Query.Result} does not have its own {@link Genai.Query.ResultToSourceRelation#displayName}.

structuredQuerySpec.description: The structured query spec that was used as the source during the query.

sourceCode.description: The final source code generated by the agent.

serializedTrajectory.description: A string representation of the agent's trajectory.
